messages:
tess: kicking off a short sync on the 'dynamic-traffic-steering alpha' rollout. goal: test multi-variant routing (cost vs quality) with per-tenant opt-outs, clear telemetry gates, and an operator soft-stop. thoughts?
rafael: love the name. lean proposal: phased regions (us-west1 -> us-east1 -> eu-west1), two-week soak overall but 24-48h per-step for hard signals. cohort by tenant tier + explicit whitelist for internal QA tenants.
nina: agree on white-listing QA. for cohorts we should use explicit tenant lists + fallback percentages rather than vague global pct. makes rollbacks deterministic.
claire: telemetry gates suggestion: p99 latency delta > 25% OR client-visible error rate +0.75% absolute OR model-quality drift (semantic BLEU-like score drop) > 3 points over baseline. gate window = 15m.
ops-bot: alert-bot: new composite alert created: dyn-steer-alpha-composite. thresholds: p99_delta_15m=25, err_rate_abs=0.75, quality_drift_15m=3. routing hooks enabled.
josh: add token-spend anomaly too: sudden tokens-per-response +40% for cohort => auto-cut. Also quota-shedding if tenant hits 85% of daily token cap.
tess: fallback plan: immediate traffic-swap to pinned fallback route (v2-stable) for affected tenant cohort + mark rollout status = PAUSED. Auto-retry path: after 12m evaluate, if p99 < threshold for 10m then resume to previous allocation. Manual rollback window = 1h.
rafael: for burst detection we should require sustained signal: both 5m and 30m windows exceed thresholds before auto-page. avoids noisy pages.
nina: I captured a flag payload sketch (YAML) to be used by the flag-service: ```yaml
flag: dynamic_traffic_steering_alpha
cohorts:
  - name: internal_qa
    tenants: [redwood-int-1, redwood-int-2]
    pct: 0
  - name: enterprise
    selector: tier==enterprise
    pct: 3
  - name: standard
    selector: tier==standard
    pct: 1
regions: [us-west1, us-east1, eu-west1]
fallback:
  mode: route_swap
  target: v2-stable
  auto_resume_after: 12m
  manual_rollback_window: 60m
soft_stop: true
```
sam: two operational asks: 1) provide a per-tenant soft-kill API so customer-ops can pause traffic per tenant; 2) shadow-compare: route mirrored requests to v3-small for 72h to collect quality/cost delta, store results in s3 bucket with redaction.
claire: add privacy constraint: shadow logs must redact PII and obey opt-out flags. include an explicit retention TTL (30d) for shadow artifacts.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: alpha rollout started: dynamic-traffic-steering -> us-west1, cohort=enterprise-3pct, rollout_id=roll-1777777000. monitoring attached: latency,error,token_spend,quality_diff.
josh: we should run a short manual human sample review after 6h for golden cohort outputs. ops-runbook: who signs off? suggest product lead + ML reviewer + oncall.
tess: signoff list: product(owner=tess) + ml(reviewer=rafael) + oncall(engineer=claire). add checklist item: run synthetic 1k-query set and compare top-k output similarity.
rafael: A/B shadow details: don't expose A/B to users. shadow sampling should be deterministic hash-based per-tenant so we don't skew production metrics.
nina: I'll wire the flag payload and add the per-endpoint SLA baselines into config-store (30d baseline window). will also add a small job to compute quality baselines nightly.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: alpha checkpoint: quiesced for review after 8h (rollout_id=roll-1777777000). stored samples -> s3://rollouts/dyn-steer/1777777000/samples.jsonl.
sam: scheduling a dry-run tomorrow to exercise the soft-stop and resume flows. please ack when you've scanned the runbook.
tess: Acked.
rafael: Acked.
nina: Acked.
claire: Acked.
